notes: Added initial story set for Provider Detail Lookup feature.

change_log.value: Schema and contract for provider detail response
Core NPI lookup and normalization logic
Expose provider detail via Evaluate Care facade
Unit and integration tests for provider detail lookup

EVAL-F-002-S1.title: Define Provider Detail Schema and Contract
EVAL-F-002-S1.description: Define a structured response schema for provider detail including specialty, license, status, address, phone, and enumeration date aligned to NPI Registry output and internal normalization needs.

EVAL-F-002-S2.title: Implement NPI Registry Lookup and Normalization Logic
EVAL-F-002-S2.description: Implement core service logic to call CMS NPI Registry API, extract provider credentials, and normalize fields (specialty, license status, address formatting, contact info, enumeration date).

EVAL-F-002-S3.title: Expose Provider Detail via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-F-002-S3.description: Integrate provider detail service into evaluate_care_facade and expose it through the tool routing layer for agent consumption.

EVAL-F-002-S4.title: Provider Detail Lookup Tests (Unit + Integration)
EVAL-F-002-S4.description: Create unit tests for normalization logic and integration tests for end-to-end NPI lookup through the facade ensuring correct field mapping and error handling.
